prior_032_findings_retained.reported: 60 psi typical and 35 psi stabilized compression are used as Fc scenarios.
prior_032_findings_retained.checked: The correct Fc is min(compression, core tension, facing-core bond). Neither scenario establishes the bonded sandwich value. Typical crush 35 psi happens to equal minimum-average stabilized compression numerically, but represents a different property.
prior_032_findings_retained.followup: Preserve the conditional labels; supply matching core tensile and Be-bond flatwise data before converting the scenario into an allowable.

prior_032_findings_retained.reported: Owner calls 35 psi the stabilized minimum.
prior_032_findings_retained.checked: Table II labels min as minimum average for a product type, not a guaranteed pointwise or full-hull minimum. Ec is typical. Pairing these values is a scenario, not a statistical lower tolerance bound.
prior_032_findings_retained.followup: Use the precise source label and a qualified statistical/material basis for any design allowable.

prior_032_findings_retained.reported: The table's compression data are from a 0.625 inch specimen.
prior_032_findings_retained.checked: 0.625 inch is 15.875 mm; the requested cores are 20.21 and 30.12 mm. No matching thickness/bonded-state validation was supplied.
prior_032_findings_retained.followup: Retain QUESTIONABLE until relevant properties are measured or supported for the actual construction.

prior_032_findings_retained.checked: Relative to sqrt(Ef*Ec*tf/tc), the effective coefficient is 0.82*sqrt(eta)/(1+0.64*Kdelta). For a fixed target Q, amplitude changes with eta. Plasticity in the nearly strength-limited faces is not calibrated.
prior_032_findings_retained.followup: Use a measured constitutive/plasticity basis self-consistently; supplemental eta cases here are PROJECTION, not new material data.

prior_032_findings_retained.reported: Amplitude/cell ratios are supplied beside inherited dimpling margins.
prior_032_findings_retained.checked: Those ratios do not identify wavelength or mode separation. CR-1457 explicitly allows dimples to precipitate wrinkling. Dimpling uses a different biaxial factor (0.5) from wrinkling's cubic root.
prior_032_findings_retained.followup: Measure the directional waveform spectrum and use a coupled assessment or matching experiment; do not apply the wrinkling multiplier to the dimpling formula.

prior_032_findings_retained.reported: Commercial panel bows and core flatness are compared to the waviness amplitudes; Be class values were not read.
prior_032_findings_retained.checked: Quoted product numbers reproduce, but geometry, material, ± convention, hold-down, wavelength and load state differ. The primary SAE public record does not verify the three-class claim or give flatness numbers.
prior_032_findings_retained.followup: Obtain Be-specific finished/bonded-panel metrology near the relevant wavelengths; retain unverified SAE details as such.

prior_032_findings_retained.reported: b=0.6823 is applied to the uniaxial stress containing waviness.
prior_032_findings_retained.checked: The algebra is correct for equal directional uniaxial capacities and does not count waviness twice. The handbook's flat-plate rule alone does not validate the loaded curved Be sandwich or establish equal directional capacity.
prior_032_findings_retained.followup: Retain the algebraic result and QUESTIONABLE transfer; validate the actual biaxial construction and relevant directional capacities.

prior_032_findings_retained.reported: The 0.33 design coefficient is inverted as an illustrative wave amplitude.
prior_032_findings_retained.checked: The arithmetic is correct but this is not a measured defect distribution or proof of why the empirical knockdown has that value. The owner already tags these rows PROJECTION.
prior_032_findings_retained.followup: Keep the existing projection label and source-test limitations.

prior_032_findings_retained.reported: CARD says lead amplitudes span 0.0046–0.024 of the 9.525 mm cell.
prior_032_findings_retained.checked: The lead-only ratios are 0.006847549228760197 and 0.01604921436707204. The printed endpoints are the two cross-Q rows among all four 60 psi cases. The underlying four rows are correct.
prior_032_findings_retained.followup: Change the label to all four typical-strength cases, or use the lead-only range.

prior_032_findings_retained.reported: The specified brief rounds both geometry and required Q; many decimal digits are displayed.
prior_032_findings_retained.checked: Using the full pinned 021/021b geometry and required Q gives conditional 60 psi amplitudes 0.15313481918912647 and 0.06513526466329604 mm. The brief-based rows differ by -0.1737373278% and +0.1345534421%, respectively. This is intentional input precision, not an error in the requested calculation.

original.note: Fc is the lower of flatwise compression, flatwise tension and the face-to-core bond. The sheet prints stabilised compression, 60 psi typical and 35 psi minimum. It does not print flatwise tension or a beryllium bond. A weaker bond lowers the allowed amplitude in proportion. The crush column, 35 psi, is not that peak.
Table II says the test thickness is 0.625 inch. The lead cores are 20.21 mm and 30.12 mm. Ec is typical only. No minimum modulus is printed.

The page says elastic cases use eta = 1, and inelastic cases use section 9. The map uses eta = 1. The 021 faces sit at compression safety factor about 1, so a plasticity factor may apply. It is not in this Q map.
Section 2.2.2 does not print the critical half-wavelength. FPL 1810-A says cell size changes that wavelength. Delta over the 9.525 mm cell is an amplitude ratio, not a separation of modes.

AMS7902H defines three flatness classes. The class numbers were not read. Bonded-panel numbers found here are long-wave bows or an architectural wave. Hexcel's design note that a large cell telegraphs into a thin face gives no depth. None of those is the Fourier component in equation 2.2-13.

Equation 2.2-15 is recommended for biaxial compression. The foam section bases its interaction on flat plates of large aspect ratio. The honeycomb page does not show a biaxial waviness test. The hull radius is 10 m.
Inverting equation 2.2-12 at Q 0.33 is stored so the design value can be seen as an amplitude. The handbook selected 0.33 from a test plot.
The card names Norris, Ericksen and Kommers. FPL Report 1810 is Norris, Ericksen and March. Kommers was not found on it.

new_findings.claim: CARD attributes 3 um to the completed CSO surface against its template.
new_findings.evidence: Woody p.684 assigns 3 um to parabolic-template adjustment; the laboratory surface estimate is 10 um.
new_findings.disposition: Relabel the 3 um result and its ratios. Numeric conversion passes; surface attribution does not.

new_findings.claim: The source text pages do not name the face thicknesses.
new_findings.evidence: ER-1001 Fig.22 maps Fig.25 specimen30 to .008-in H19/Crest471/3/16-in core. Fig.30 gives .008-in face/APS/.015-in fillet for specimen32.
new_findings.disposition: The report's figures fill the identity gap. They do not establish Be or CR-III equivalence.

new_findings.claim: Numerical depth/RMS/slope-to-delta comparisons can be mistaken for modal comparisons.
new_findings.evidence: Dimple depth is not zero-to-peak Fourier amplitude; RMS requires a spatial model. A sine uses depth/2 or sqrt(2)*RMS.
new_findings.disposition: Keep number-only labels and metrology bandwidth. Single-sine examples are projections, not fitted measurements.

new_findings.claim: 032b did not retrieve the Rion thin-face waviness experiment.
new_findings.evidence: Rion 2008 thesis has direct cell-depth measurements near its own calculated wrinkle half-wavelength; detailed values and material scope are in CHECK/RESULTS.
new_findings.disposition: Evidence exists for a different system; no measured Be/CR-III modal amplitude follows. Preserve the empirical shape conversion.

new_findings.claim: The target wrinkle wavelength was not computed in 032/032b.
new_findings.evidence: Elastic symmetric flat-panel Eq.19 gives full periods 38.5470 and 36.7051 mm at nu=0; alternative nu=.33 is only sensitivity.
new_findings.disposition: A conditional band is now specified. Curvature, biaxiality, material tangent properties, other modes and actual measured spectrum remain unresolved.

new_findings.claim: The 'exceeded today' field includes a 1969 honeycomb vendor RMS.
new_findings.evidence: Von Hoerner p.2 attributes the .008-in figure to discussions with Rohr; no new honeycomb-cell measurements are supplied there.
new_findings.disposition: Label it historical whole-surface capability evidence; do not infer a current production distribution or wrinkle-band exceedance.
